g.title: j1250280689
g.text: Roathe told me about... the fight with Tagfer. Can we talk about it?

g.title: j3022194826->j1250280689
g.text: true

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3022194826->j242691715

g.title: j315489333
g.text: Oui, though I feel as though I know what this is about... I have behaved poorly. Who told you ?

g.title: j1337568856
g.text: Bien sûr, ce salaud de diable ouvre sa bouche et vous raconte tout ! Il ne cherche qu'à m'embarrasser !

g.title: j3787189457
g.text: It's not important.

g.title: j3063977456
g.text: Loid.

g.title: j1125000625
g.text: Roathe.

g.title: j3514575613
g.text: Si je le pouvais, je prendrais ce couteau qu'il aime tant utiliser pour agacer les autres et je le fourrerais là où seule Lua peut le voir !

g.title: j256476748
g.text: I think it is, but I think you are wishing to spare my mood. So... I will not press you for more.

g.title: j3391523357
g.text: I think you are lying to spare my mood, so... I will not press you for more.

g.title: j3984064372
g.text: Forgive me. That was... untoward. I am une Sœur de Sol, and I must not lose my temper or loosen my tongue in such a way.

g.title: j79892233
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2601599241
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3559668994
g.text: I wish to keep what little dignity in this conversation that I might be allowed.

g.title: j1584239485
g.text: My anger is not directed at you. And I am always grateful for your honesty.

g.title: j2154874870
g.text: If you have come to speak with me about the row I had with M'sieur Tagfer, I shall not deny it occurred.

g.title: j2682702563
g.text: I assume the devil told you what the fight was regarding?

g.title: j370765590
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1891661554
g.text: He didn't need to tell me, I could guess. Entrati.

g.title: j370765590->j1891661554
g.text: MarieTagferFight2a

g.title: j370765590->j1891661554
g.text: MarieTagferFight2b

g.title: j370765590->j1891661554
g.text: false

g.title: j3435613686
g.text: He did. Though he seemed more concerned about you than anything else.

g.title: j370765590->j3435613686
g.text: MarieTagferFight2a

g.title: j3528151173
g.text: He did. He's concerned about the situation because I think he feels for the Cavia.

g.title: j370765590->j3528151173
g.text: MarieTagferFight2b

g.title: j2696967393
g.text: No, honestly. He said only that I should check in on you.

g.title: j370765590->j2696967393
g.text: false

g.title: j1294570661
g.text: Oui. M'sieur Tagfer were arguing over the topic of le Cardinal.

g.title: j2523470877
g.text: I do not know why the devil would have you believe such a thing. Or to what end it would serve him.

g.title: j3103203397
g.text: The devil sees three wounded animals and knows he can easily wield his charisme to have them fawning over him.

g.title: j1964061934
g.text: I do not know why the devil would have you do such a thing. Or what ends he believes it would serve him.

g.title: j3533276194
g.text: Tagfer is not the biggest supporter of Entrati, no.

g.title: j3443365265
g.text: I take it that the argument was a loud one.

g.title: j1532523889
g.text: All acts of supposed kindness toward me from the devil are in service of his goal - to turn me against le Cardinal. I know it.

g.title: j1776261685
g.text: He does this to turn the tide against me. He wishes to corrupt me against le Cardinal. To see me turn my back against him. I know it.

g.title: j2244131535
g.text: But... that is not what you are here to discuss. The fight was in regards to le Cardinal.

g.title: j4224580148
g.text: And this is what I do not understand ! Look at what they have been given !

g.title: j1001049691
g.text: Oui ! He called me stupide. He told me that I am nothing but a child.

g.title: j1914431976
g.text: And it was the topic of le Cardinal that M'sieur Tagfer and I were arguing over.

g.title: j700051858
g.text: Please, start from the beginning. How did this whole fight start?

g.title: j2218686967
g.text: I can start to get a sense of why this fight happened.

g.title: j598887774
g.text: Did he actually call you stupid and a child?

g.title: j42973223
g.text: Oui. I made mention of le Cardinal, I do not even know what it was.

g.title: j975115575
g.text: Worse, perhaps.

g.title: j2265098168
g.text: M'sieur Tagfer rolled his eyes and snorted. I asked him to explain his derision.

g.title: j15467890
g.text: "You're a spawnling, Marie ! Innocent. Dependent on others your whole life. Curled up in your little nest of blind faith !"

g.title: j2074191935
g.text: "Albrecht is a dirty, stinking liar !"

g.title: j512673816
g.text: "Surviving on what your elders chewed up and spat into your credulous gaping mouth-hole !"

g.title: j2622389259
g.text: Et j'ai répondu, "Look at the gifts you were given - the gifts of thought, of language, of Self!"

g.title: j471012429
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati3 is now true.

g.title: j3490711374
g.text: "You should be grateful to le Cardinal for all he has blessed you with."

g.title: j956182981
g.text: Tagfer only knows his side of the story. Entrati's real motivations or opinions weren't... clearly explained.

g.title: j1144656429
g.text: I know how you feel about being "dependent" on others and I'm sorry he said those things to you.

g.title: j1590477619
g.text: Tagfer has good reasons to feel the way he does.

g.title: j3482162566
g.text: And how did he take that?

g.title: j2146973782
g.text: Oh, no...

g.title: j3442161619
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3015017109
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j946548047
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j350584114
g.text: It still does not give him a right ! I do not know if he realizes how deep his words cut me. En outre -

g.title: j2642182748
g.text: Merci, I do not know if he knows how deep the knife of his words cut me.

g.title: j2672902935
g.text: If this is the welcome le Cardinal looks forward to enjoying upon his return, it is no wonder he stays away !

g.title: j946548047->j2672902935
g.text: MarieEntratiFamily

g.title: j1300833956
g.text: And I am certain you take M'sieur Tagfer's side in all this, non ? You believe le Cardinal to be a monster just the same as the beast does.

g.title: j946548047->j1300833956
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j946548047->j1300833956
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j2882235416
g.text: I am surprised, je pensais que tu étais de mon côté ! Were you not joining me in championing le Cardinal's cause but a moment ago ?

g.title: j946548047->j2882235416
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j946548047->j2882235416
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j1311763800
g.text: What does it matter, as you said before ? We are to serve him in his deeds and judge him later. This fight is meaningless, non ?

g.title: j946548047->j1311763800
g.text: MarieEntratiNeutral

g.title: j340015026
g.text: I know they were made by the Void at le Cardinal's hands. All of us have been given gifts by le Cardinal that are a curse if viewed with a broken heart !

g.title: j946548047->j340015026
g.text: false

g.title: j4278649408
g.text: And do you know how deeply yours did? Do you know their whole story?

g.title: j1502762853
g.text: And what you said hurt him just as much.

g.title: j2851445484
g.text: I'm honestly on your side, but... we have to try to keep the peace, Marie.

g.title: j448634185
g.text: Marie, please. I'm not trying to fight. I'm just trying to get you to understand what they've been through.

g.title: j3730011247
g.text: If Entrati stuck around to help clean up after his own messes, he might have more friends in this world.

g.title: j3891907750
g.text: Yes, I am taking his side. Because you're not listening to reason. You have to understand "le Cardinal" is not what he seems.

g.title: j287250475
g.text: Has this been some great deception of yours ? Have you been playing un jeu with little Marie ?

g.title: j2065386270
g.text: It matters if there's nobody left around us when we're on the other side of this. They've been through a lot.

g.title: j3993377168
g.text: I'm sure he'll forget about it. I'm sure you will, too.

g.title: j162325153
g.text: All of us have been abandoned by him ! Tell me, how are they so much more wronged, that I must tolerate such hate ?!

g.title: j1829289903
g.text: Oui ?! Then tell me why !

g.title: j950081703
g.text: The situation that the Cavia have been through has been... hard.

g.title: j2355058048
g.text: They're animals, even if they've been given intelligence, they're still animals. There's only so much they're capable of.

g.title: j1425163818
g.text: Oui ? Then do play the role of La Lumière Sacrée de Sol and banish the darkness ! Enlighten little foolish Marie !

g.title: j3582361651
g.text: Oui ! Yes, it is not good enough that he is attempting to save the known universe from a god of the Void, non ?!

g.title: j3595421778
g.text: No, I'm not lying. I'm with you. I'm just saying their situation has been... hard.

g.title: j2180887988
g.text: No, not a game, exactly...? Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.

g.title: j3395151276
g.text: Non ! You began this conversation, and you will continue it. Explique !

g.title: j1639327012
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j1176667549
g.text: If you are attempting to inspire me to sympathize instead with them and turn my wrath upon you, I am suddenly tempted.

g.title: j568183550
g.text: Perhaps it is best we adjourn here. Before tempers get the best of all of us.

g.title: j291213218
g.text: Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.

g.title: j516809325
g.text: The Cavia were accidents created from experiments. Lab animals never meant to exist. The Void gave them intelligence.

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: MarieFamily2

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: MarieBackstory1

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: MarieInfestation

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: MarieLyonSuffering2

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: MarrieLyonSuffering3

g.title: j1639327012->j516809325
g.text: false

g.title: j896624896
g.text: You said yourself "It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name." Entrati never bothered to name them, they were that worthless.

g.title: j1639327012->j896624896
g.text: MarieFamily2

g.title: j2536152567
g.text: You told me the story of how you grew up on the streets. How your family threw you out because you weren't good enough for them.

g.title: j1639327012->j2536152567
g.text: MarieBackstory1

g.title: j2844187064
g.text: Think about how you would have felt, if you had simply been turned into a protoframe against your will and then abandoned?

g.title: j1639327012->j2844187064
g.text: MarieInfestation

g.title: j2141974037
g.text: Imagine how you would feel if Entrati just swooped in, turned Lyon into a protoframe, and abandoned him?

g.title: j1639327012->j2141974037
g.text: MarieLyonSuffering2

g.title: j1509439757
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan1 is now false.

g.title: j221421017
g.text: And when Entrati saw what he had done? When he realized what he had created? These poor animals, speaking in Void-tongue, sick from exposure?

g.title: j741466013
g.text: They were just things to him. Things to be used and thrown away. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."

g.title: j2819116386
g.text: Your family thought you were worthless.

g.title: j1641439469
g.text: Imagine what it would have been like to have the Infestation in your blood, suffering, with no one there to say they cared?

g.title: j2317866339
g.text: Used him like a cheap science experiment, and then washed his hands of him? You all had each other to rely on before and after you changed. The Cavia didn't.

g.title: j2631316640
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan2 is now false.

g.title: j3834711729
g.text: He didn't care.

g.title: j2930810524
g.text: Bird 3? He's a bird with a number for a name. Fibonacci gave himself his name.

g.title: j3047942080
g.text: That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."

g.title: j1882864139
g.text: That your suffering even mattered? The Cavia were - are - worthless to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."

g.title: j2124753711
g.text: To Entrati, the Cavia were just disposable lab animals. Worthless. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."

g.title: j1508231473
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j1368624670
g.text: That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."

g.title: j2051332121
g.text: Used in a Void experiment. Survivors in a long line of dead animals. Never intended to exist.

g.title: j3933770226
g.text: The last of his kind. Tag For Disposal. His mate? Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.

g.title: j2334629120
g.text: It's only because of Loid that they're still alive. He preserved them because he couldn't bring himself to euthanize them "per Entrati's instructions."

g.title: j4109125800
g.text: That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.

g.title: j3933426006
g.text: Oh, and Tagfer? He's the last of his kind. His mate, Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.

g.title: j2433363310
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati3b is now true.

g.title: j2339498702
g.text: That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.

g.title: j254650997
g.text: I know you believe he's doing what he thinks he needs to. And I know you believe in forgiveness. So do I. But you have to understand why for some people it's not possible. At least not yet.

g.title: j2531360100
g.text: There are some times when forgiveness isn't possible for people to muster for those who have hurt them. Certainly not now, and maybe not ever.

g.title: j2070717389
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati3a is now true.

g.title: j890665550
g.text: I know you believe he's doing what he thinks he needs to. And I know you believe in forgiveness. So do I. But you have to understand why for some people it's not possible. At least not yet.

g.title: j3585787151
g.text: There are some times when forgiveness isn't possible for people to muster for those who have hurt them. Certainly not now, and maybe not ever.

g.title: j2670034519
g.text: We can only help Tagfer heal the best we can. And hope some day he lets go of the pain.

g.title: j1423705570
g.text: And either way, it's not up for us to decide if and when Tagfer forgives Entrati. That's up to Tagfer.

g.title: j3734659169
g.text: You have made your case. And... it has been heard. I must go. I have much to think about. We will discuss this again soon when my thoughts are clear.

g.title: j2376375177
g.text: We can only help Tagfer heal the best we can. And hope some day he lets go of the pain.

g.title: j1093447551
g.text: And either way, it's not up for us to decide if and when Tagfer forgives Entrati. That's up to Tagfer.

g.title: j1745824381
g.text: You... have given me much to think about. I fear I have no words. I must... I must go, and we will discuss this again soon, when my thoughts are clear.
